# BridgeTap 1.7.0 - OneClient HUD styles, server presets and replay video export

Minecraft **1.8.9** - **Forge** and **OneClient / Ornithe Fabric** editions. Install exactly one edition. The Fabric JAR uses Ornithe mappings; it is not compatible with arbitrary Legacy Fabric/Yarn profiles.

## Added

- Optional OneClient/OneConfig integration, credited **by sggn**, with native settings and three independent HUD-editor overlays: bridge coordinates, replay information and replay keystrokes.
- Native RGB color pickers, text/background/shadow styling, and independent pressed/released keystroke colors. The original replay, island and preset menus remain available.
- **Velo Z decimals (jump -1t)**: display the fractional absolute Z coordinate one tick before each jump beside its flat/speed entry. Each entry keeps its own sample. Enable the option in HUD settings; choose **Velo** in Overlay colors or the coordinate HUD's OneClient Settings tab. Jump-coordinate offsets do not change this sample.
- Per-server island preset bindings, portable `.btpreset` sharing, and undo/redo for grouped island-editor changes.
- Replay MP4 export at 30/60/120 FPS with recorded keystrokes/CPS, POV/follow/overview cameras, a construction-block hotbar, and a frozen ending showing the saved run time. Replay-video exports are silent because replay recordings do not contain game audio.
- Evidence-based fail analysis that reports recorded observations without guessing missing data.
- McPlay-only mode detection and mode filters/subfolders: **16 blocks = Extra Short**, **28 = Short**, **51 = Normal**, **83 = Long**. Height is ignored; other servers retain Unknown unless supported separately. Parent server folders include all their mode subfolders. Personal folder assignments are preserved.
- Gradle Wrapper and a portable build producing both editions in `build/libs`.

## Fixed

- Preset anchoring against the original start island and clear, unblurred world placement views.
- Replay placement/input alignment: new v5 recordings retain the original starting pose and use a consistent tick-boundary timeline. Tagged v4 recordings receive the compatible playback correction without rewriting their original timestamps.
- Replay sticks have no navigation cooldown: **one tick while paused**, **one second while playing**. Pause/speed/exit retain their own input handling.
- Native clip readback fallbacks and replay-video frame scheduling/backpressure.

## Downloads and upgrade

- **Forge:** `BridgeTap-1.7.0-Forge-1.8.9.jar` (Java 8+, tested with Forge 11.15.1.2318).
- **OneClient / Ornithe Fabric:** `BridgeTap-1.7.0-OneClient.jar`. Standalone Ornithe works without OneConfig; native OneClient integration requires OneConfig 1.7.0 and Java 21+ with its normal dependencies.
- Replace the previous BridgeTap JAR, keep only one edition, and restart Minecraft. Existing replay/island/preset data remains readable. Older summaries cannot reconstruct missing pre-jump samples.
- **Native clips/audio and Windows replay-video encoding now use a separate optional tools pack:** [BridgeTap-clip-tools-windows-x64.zip](https://github.com/sgggnnn/bridgetap/releases/download/v1.7.0/BridgeTap-clip-tools-windows-x64.zip). Extract it into your Minecraft game directory (the directory containing `mods`), producing `config/bridgetap/tools/ffmpeg.exe` and `config/bridgetap/tools/bridgetap-loopback.exe`. Restart the buffer afterward. Previously extracted tools with the correct pinned hashes are also supported.
- The mod JARs contain no executable binaries and never download or extract tools at runtime. Installed tools are checksum-verified. This is not a guarantee against antivirus detections; do not disable protection or add exclusions as a workaround.
- The rolling clip buffer starts OFF each launch. F9 saves the recent buffer. Windows audio records the default output, including other apps on that device, and never records the microphone.

...

# BridgeTap 1.6.0 - Islands, clips and replay organization

Minecraft **1.8.9** - **Forge** and **Ornithe / Legacy Fabric** editions.

## Added and fixed

- Final release of the dev.11 code, including all 1.6 development features.
- Copy both islands from a replay; preview and position start/finish separately, change their distance, rotate, rename, export and apply named presets in one click.
- Fixed preset anchoring against original start-island geometry so moving the camera or starting a run one block away does not shift a new preset.
- Focus mode hides surrounding native terrain and filters remote spatial sounds while preserving local interactions and non-positional interface audio.
- Readable island export filenames with numbered duplicates; older UUID exports are renamed when opening the island library.
- Windows rolling H.264 video buffer with default-output audio, 15/30/60-second windows, 60/120 FPS options, hardware encoder selection and bounded memory/disk usage.
- Parallel image conversion for 120 FPS; the existing 60 FPS conversion path is retained.
- Default replay file manager with server folders, search, sorting, successful-only and imported-only filters, expanded bridge coordinates and protected saves.
- Optional deletion of unprotected failed runs after 48 hours, OFF by default.
- Client-only appearance selection for tracked placed blocks.

## Upgrade notes

- Replace the old BridgeTap JAR with exactly one matching edition and restart Minecraft.
- Position and save legacy presets once more to use the fixed island anchor. Existing replay/island data remains readable.
- The video buffer starts OFF each launch. Enable it before playing; F9 saves the recent buffer.
- Windows audio captures the default output, including other applications on that device; no microphone is captured. Other platforms use the silent compatibility exporter.
- Actual 120 FPS capture requires a game frame rate of at least 120, compatible GPU readback and sufficient encoder throughput. Disable VSync or raise the game FPS cap if needed.
- Focus sound filtering uses source positions; Minecraft 1.8.9 sound packets do not identify the originating player.

## Validation

- Replay, island, preset, folder, retention, audio-policy and capture regression suites.
- Native MP4/AAC exports at 60 and 120 FPS over 30 seconds, decoded frame counts and distinct-frame checks.
- All 43 native hooks/accessors and real Forge/LaunchWrapper startup, including native island placement, stable preset positions and Focus sound filtering.
- Actual menu drawing and interaction checks. Automated tests do not replace in-game rendering/performance checks with other installed mods.

## Downloads

- `BridgeTap-1.6.0-Forge-1.8.9.jar`: Forge 1.8.9.
- `BridgeTap-1.6.0.jar`: Ornithe / Legacy Fabric 1.8.9 using Ornithe intermediary mappings.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for both editions.

Install one edition in the instance's `mods` folder and restart Minecraft.

## Source

This tag contains the complete 1.6.0 source tree, promoted from dev.11. See the [feature guide](https://github.com/sgggnnn/bridgetap/blob/v1.6.0/docs/ISLANDS-AND-CLIPS.md) for controls and limitations.

# BridgeTap 1.6.0-dev.10 - Hardware clip buffer, presets, Focus and protected saves

**Historical development pre-release.** Superseded by [BridgeTap 1.6.0](https://github.com/sgggnnn/bridgetap/releases/tag/v1.6.0).

Minecraft **1.8.9** - **Forge** and **Ornithe / Legacy Fabric** editions.

## Changes in this build

- Continuous native H.264 rolling disk buffer on Windows, hardware encoder selection and MP4 remuxing with output audio.
- Bounded reusable raw-frame memory and up to a 2 GiB segment buffer instead of the short PNG memory ring.
- Named one-click island presets, independent start/finish positioning and larger v4 island templates with explicit part membership.
- Focus mode and client-only placed-block appearance selection.
- Protected Save replay action and optional cleanup of unprotected failed recordings after 48 hours.
- Successful-only and imported-only filters in the default replay file manager.

## Downloads

- `BridgeTap-1.6.0-dev.10-Forge-1.8.9.jar`: Forge 1.8.9.
- `BridgeTap-1.6.0-dev.10.jar`: Ornithe / Legacy Fabric 1.8.9 using Ornithe intermediary mappings.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for both editions.

Install one edition in the instance's `mods` folder and restart Minecraft.

## Historical source availability

The attached JARs are the original preserved binaries for this development build. A separate source snapshot was not retained at the time. This tag's automatic source archives contain a binary manifest and checksums, **not a rebuildable historical code snapshot**. Complete consolidated sources are available in [v1.6.0](https://github.com/sgggnnn/bridgetap/tree/v1.6.0).

Later builds fix known issues in these historical previews. Install the final release for normal use.
